blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No bettor won the ₱85.48 million jackpot in the Lotto 6/42 draw or the ₱40.17 million jackpot in the Super Lotto 6/49 draw on Thursday, Oct. 8, 2026, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO). The Lotto 6/42 draw produced the winning combination 19-01-20-39-23-11, with a jackpot prize of ₱85.48 million. No ticket holder matched all six numbers. Similarly, the Super Lotto 6/49 draw yielded the winning combination 41-19-04-01-12-22, carrying a jackpot of ₱40.17 million. PCSO reported no jackpot winner.
